subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Beneficial Ownership Registers
description: A 60-second lesson on Beneficial Ownership Registers.

hook.text: Who really owns that company? In many countries, the answer is hidden behind layers of anonymous entities.

buildup.text: Beneficial ownership registers require companies to disclose the real humans who ultimately control them.

discovery.text: The US Corporate Transparency Act (2024) requires most companies to report beneficial owners to FinCEN.

twist.text: The EU planned public registers but its court ruled that public access violated privacy rights.

climax.text: Transparency and privacy are in tension. Knowing who owns what is essential for fighting financial crime.

punchline.text: Who owns the company? For the first time, you must answer.

quiz.question: What does the US Corporate Transparency Act require?
options: Companies must report their real beneficial owners to FinCEN
All companies must become publicly traded
Companies must publish all financial records
